purpose: Frozen development/repeat listening references; no engine coefficient, pick force or geometry fitted to recordings. Not an exact-eight calibration corpus.
asset_root: User-selected external asset directory; audio and third-party MIDI are not committed. Paths below are relative to this receipt acquisition root.
acquisition: Download each official archive URL; verify its published MD5 if downloading the whole archive; extract only named members under assets/ retaining original bytes; verify member CRC32 and SHA256. P3/EG-IPT may also be fetched by HTTP byte ranges, checking decoded member length/CRC before SHA256.

sources.attribution: Pedroza, Hegel; Abreu, Wallace; Corey, Ryan M.; Roman, Iran R. Guitar-TECHS: An Electric Guitar Dataset Covering Techniques, Musical Excerpts, Chords and Scales Using a Diverse Array of Hardware. ICASSP 2025.
sources.di_evidence: Primary project Recording Setup: guitar output→signal splitter→audio interface and separately mic-recorded amplifier. Only directinput WAV members selected.
sources.p1: Ibanez PF300, .011-.050, bridge pickup, Audient ID14. Six-string standard EADGBE source annotations.
sources.p3: Sire T7, .010-.046, bridge-neck pickups, UMC202HD; independent per-string MIDI tracks named e/B/G/D/A/E, channels0..5.
sources.timing_warning: Dataset release warns inter-modality offsets up to100ms; phrases retain original event timing plus one documented global offset, never quantized.

limits: Professional-player 2005 Gibson SG Standard six-string proxy; BSS AR-133 DI box through Midas XL48; 96 kHz/24-bit mono.
Filename 6s identifies string 6; identifier 02 does not document fret or open-string tuning. E2-like pitch is independently measured, not filename-derived.
Source scale, string gauge, pick force/direction and normalization are not documented by the dataset; model scale0/gauge0/velocity0.85 are shared hypotheses, not fitted matches.
Only about 19 ms pre-onset exists in the published file; preserve all of it, with no fabricated silent pre-roll.
One separate performance per pickup; prior Electry research analyzed these same assets, so these are development checks, not independent held-out captures.

source.attribution: Hegel Pedroza, Wallace Abreu, Ryan M. Corey and Iran R. Roman. Guitar-TECHS (ICASSP 2025), DOI:10.5281/zenodo.14963133. CC BY 4.0. DI channel0 selection, fixed crops and constant listening trims by Electry research.
limits: P3 Sire T7 six-string .010-.046, bridge-neck pickups, UMC202HD; signal splitter→interface raw DI. Native48kHz/24-bit stereo is exact dual mono; channel0 explicitly selected, never averaged.
Only released E-string MIDI events are selected; no other string is MIDI-active in the crop. Residual body/sympathetic sound is not guaranteed absent.

Score times/velocities are unquantized Fishman tracker annotations, not verified pick force or fretting-versus-picking labels. Keep the 47→48 on-before-old-off overlap and same-pitch49 repick; no hand articulation invented.

One constant MIDI→audio offset is measured from the first development note only and shared by both crops; repeat first audio onset differs from that prediction by −0.478ms. No per-note warp, spectral matching or pitch correction.
Shipping GuitarBuild0.8 model controls are identical across A/B and deliberately not a hardware fit: extended heavy eight-string/bridge differs from this lighter six-string/bridge-neck setup.
Second excerpt is a structural repeat check on the same newly examined recording/player/guitar, not an independent hardware holdout.
Crop ends before the next multi-string chord while the final C#3 is still held. Do not add a fabricated source NoteOff or decay tail.
Conservative crop end5.900s or16.550s excludes the following multi-string chord/pick precursor; guard chosen from source events and source high-band rise, independently of candidate output.

No per-hit alignment, hidden quantization, pitch correction, EQ or source velocity→physical-force calibration. Listening trim is constant whole-crop RMS and reported by packager.
